details: Responsibilities
• Attended workshops to gather business requirements and mapping the system as per the
business requirement.
• Documented the AS-IS and TO-BE for Inbound, Outbound and Internal Processes.

• Defining and Mapping the ECC & EWM warehouses.
• Transfer Master Data and transactional data from ECC to EWM system.
• Define EWM warehouse structure, storage types, sections and creation of bins.
• Configuration of storage type search sequence and warehouse process types.

• Knowledge on warehouse monitor, condition records, Replenishment and Physical inventory,
Yard Management, Labor management.
• Worked in the post-implementation phase to support the go-live in a new warehouse.

details: Responsibilities
• Responsible for handling Incidents/Service Requests.
• Used Ticketing tool Service now to handle incidents.
• Handled the role of primary on call support for 3 warehouses.
• Worked on tickets having high priority (SLA 4 hours).
• Resolving SAP operational issues related to interfaces, change management, Process change
management, including optimization of business processes.
• Leading customer workshops.
• Perform root cause analysis on major software & application related problems.
• Queue Monitor SMQ2/SMQ1.
• Production support that involves end to end maintenance with time frame accordance to SLA.
• Responsible for handling CRs and coordinating with Client project team.
• Worked on Interface issues like EDI/IDOC.
• Create documentation on new issues resolved, route cause analysis as well as troubleshooting
steps attempted prior to closing or escalation incidents.
• Extensively used the warehouse monitor and RF for resolving live issues.
• Primarily supported the issues related to:
Inbound processes – Unloading, Deconsolidation, Put away
Outbound processes – Picking, packing, loading, Goods issue
Internal Process (Rearrangement, Replenishment, Scrapping, Physical Inventory).
